B, your panic about leaving things unresolved sounds real. Still, standing in the only doorway after A asked to leave kept A in the room against their will for five minutes, and A felt afraid. Even when the goal is to keep talking, blocking someone's exit is not okay. It can make a person feel unsafe. A, wanting space was a reasonable request. Going forward, you could agree on a pause rule: either person can step away, and you both commit to a set time to come back to the conversation. If either of you ever feels unsafe, a counselor or a domestic violence hotline can help."}
